smoothing.rule: (a) (eps^2/(4 d_b) + eps^2/(4 d_d^I)) |dq/dT| <= tau/10 for beta, x, y and <= 0.1 of the tolerance for K and h (reference_values_real.yaml measured.smoothing_predicted, smoothing_predicted_K_h_at_1e-4); (b) |T_eq - T| x max_abs_dq_dT, max_abs_dlnK_dT, max_abs_dh_dT <= 0.1 of the tolerance at each selected two-phase attempt (spec 16 A3-7)

tau_mapping_check.rule: tau[j, i] = -ln Lambda_ij (spec 8.1); generator transcription reference_values_real.yaml idaes_mapping
